nom: First Aid Beauty Ultra Repair Face Lotion

segments.dry: Reviewers who describe their skin as dry, flaky, or patchy say the lotion absorbs quickly and keeps skin hydrated, soft, and smooth through the day, with one reporting it fixed extreme dry patches around the nose and lips within a week; a few add that it isn't rich enough on its own for very dry skin, especially at night.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including several managing rosacea, eczema, or seborrheic dermatitis, say the fragrance-free, oatmeal-based formula calms redness and irritation without stinging, though two reviewers report it burned and reddened their skin on contact.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including some who are also sensitive or breakout-prone, say the lightweight formula hydrates without feeling heavy in their oilier areas.
segments.oily: A couple of reviewers with oily skin or an oily T-zone say the lightweight formula hydrates without adding shine or greasiness, though one needed to apply it cautiously in her oiliest areas.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal-to-combination skin says the lotion supplies a healthy layer of moisture without issue.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s and 50s say the lotion works well as a daytime moisturizer, though one in her 50s prefers a heavier cream at night as her skin has grown progressively drier with age.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, including many who describe their skin as dry, flaky, or patchy, report the lotion delivers noticeable, all-day hydration and softens dry patches within days; a smaller number say it doesn't last as long as expected, isn't rich enough for very dry skin at night, or became thinner and less moisturizing after a recent formula change.
concerns.redness: Many reviewers with rosacea or redness-prone skin say the colloidal oatmeal calms redness, in some cases within the same use; two reviewers, however, say the product itself caused burning and new redness when they tried it.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers say the colloidal-oatmeal formula supports or repairs a compromised skin barrier, citing use after dermaplaning, chemical peels, or during eczema and seborrheic-dermatitis flares without new irritation; two reviewers report the opposite, describing burning, redness, and inflammation on first use.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers, mostly describing a recently purchased or reformulated batch, say the lotion has broken them out or clogged pores where it never did before; others, including one who calls her skin acne-prone, report it has never caused breakouts and doesn't clog pores.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination skin say the lightweight formula absorbs without adding greasiness, though one reviewer with oily areas says a heavier-feeling batch required more cautious application there.

extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I did one pump on my hand and look at that thick lotion! I have really sensitive skin so whenever I find products that are on the thicker side, I love them!! I rubbed the product on my hand & it ended up burning my skin so bad, it made it irritated and red. I decided not to try it on my face since I've noticed when I try it on my hand & I get a irritating reaction, putting the product on my face makes it way worse and I start to feel like my face is itchy, inflamed, & really dry.
Bought this product on sale and thought it would be good for my dry sensitive/acne prone skin… unfortunately this cream it tends to not make my skin feel hydrated and breaks me out :(

extraits.titre: Works so nice on dry faces
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The first aid beauty ultra repair face lotion with colloidal oatmeal is one of the best face lotions I've ever used. The cream's consistency is not as thick as others, has a minimal scent. It applies so smoothly and soaks into my skin without leaving me greasy at all. I have several extreme dry patches-around my nose folds and lips-from extreme weather. The first aid beauty repair lotion helped fix these dry spots within a week of continuous use. Much better results than the other lotions I've used. I am extremely happy with this product.

I cannot live without this moisturizer. The moment I run out and use anything else for a period of time I am quickly reminded why it's my holy grail product. I have combination skin that tends to lean towards the dryer side during winter. I am also prone to redness, bumps, dry patches, and irritation. This is one of the only moisturizers I can use that doesn't upset my skin barrier. I am also an avid user of their facewash.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this product! It is unscented and goes on velvety smooth. It is non greasy, and easily absorbed into my skin. I have rosacea, and the colloidal oatmeal instantly calmed the redness on my cheeks. Highly recommend this product.

I received this FAB Ultra Repair Face Lotion in exchange for my honest review and I love it! It has a lightweight texture that absorbs quickly and doesn't make my oily skin feel greasy. It leaves my skin hydrated and smooth with a velvety finish. I would definitely recommend it!

This is a really nice moisturizer. It's super nourishing but feels lightweight on my skin. I struggle with eczema and colloidal oatmeal is one of my favorite ingredients, so love that it's included in this. While I can use it as my nighttime moisturizer, I prefer something a little heavier at night (I'm 50 and my skin is getting drier by the minute). But it's lovely as a daytime moisturizer. And I am always happy to see the Eczema Association Seal of Acceptance!
